title: MaStR – Installed capacity in Germany
description: Marktstammdatenregister (Bundesnetzagentur), full export. Gross capacity (Bruttoleistung) of electricity generation and storage units. 'In operation' means Betriebsstatus 'In Betrieb'. Combustion covers all fuels in EinheitenVerbrennung (coal, gas, oil, waste, hydrogen).

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, sum(kw) * 1000 AS value FROM ( SELECT 'Solar' AS tech, "Bundesland"::bigint AS state, "Bruttoleistung" AS kw, "EinheitBetriebsstatus" AS status, "Inbetriebnahmedatum" AS ibn FROM mastr."EinheitenSolar" UNION ALL SELECT CASE "WindAnLandOderAufSee" WHEN 889 THEN 'Wind offshore' ELSE 'Wind onshore' END, "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWind" UNION ALL SELECT 'Battery storage', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenStromSpeicher" UNION ALL SELECT 'Biomass', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenBiomasse" UNION ALL SELECT 'Hydro', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWasser" UNION ALL SELECT 'Combustion', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenVerbrennung" ) u WHERE tech = 'Solar' AND status = 35

panels.title: Capacity in operation by federal state
panels.description: Offshore wind is registered in the exclusive economic zone ('Ausschließliche Wirtschaftszone').

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(k."Wert", 'unknown') AS state, sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE tech = 'Solar') * 1000 AS "Solar", sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE tech = 'Wind onshore') * 1000 AS "Wind onshore", sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE tech = 'Wind offshore') * 1000 AS "Wind offshore", sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE tech = 'Battery storage') * 1000 AS "Battery storage", sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE tech IN ('Biomass', 'Hydro')) * 1000 AS "Biomass and hydro", sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE tech = 'Combustion') * 1000 AS "Combustion" FROM ( SELECT 'Solar' AS tech, "Bundesland"::bigint AS state, "Bruttoleistung" AS kw, "EinheitBetriebsstatus" AS status, "Inbetriebnahmedatum" AS ibn FROM mastr."EinheitenSolar" UNION ALL SELECT CASE "WindAnLandOderAufSee" WHEN 889 THEN 'Wind offshore' ELSE 'Wind onshore' END, "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWind" UNION ALL SELECT 'Battery storage', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenStromSpeicher" UNION ALL SELECT 'Biomass', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenBiomasse" UNION ALL SELECT 'Hydro', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWasser" UNION ALL SELECT 'Combustion', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenVerbrennung" ) u LEFT JOIN mastr."Katalogwerte" k ON k."Id" = u.state WHERE status = 35 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(kw) DESC

panels.title: Commissioned capacity per month
panels.description: Gross capacity by commissioning month (Inbetriebnahmedatum) of all units not in planning, including units decommissioned since. Recent months still grow as late registrations arrive.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', ibn::date) AS time, tech AS metric, sum(kw) * 1000 AS value FROM ( SELECT 'Solar' AS tech, "Bundesland"::bigint AS state, "Bruttoleistung" AS kw, "EinheitBetriebsstatus" AS status, "Inbetriebnahmedatum" AS ibn FROM mastr."EinheitenSolar" UNION ALL SELECT CASE "WindAnLandOderAufSee" WHEN 889 THEN 'Wind offshore' ELSE 'Wind onshore' END, "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWind" UNION ALL SELECT 'Battery storage', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenStromSpeicher" UNION ALL SELECT 'Biomass', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenBiomasse" UNION ALL SELECT 'Hydro', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWasser" UNION ALL SELECT 'Combustion', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenVerbrennung" ) u WHERE status <> 31 AND ibn >= to_char($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ibn < to_char($__timeTo()::timestamptz, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT tech AS technology, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 35) AS "units in operation", round((sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE status = 35) / 1e6)::numeric, 2) AS "GW in operation", round((sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE status = 31) / 1e6)::numeric, 2) AS "GW in planning", round((sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE status = 37) / 1e6)::numeric, 2) AS "GW temporarily shut down", round((sum(kw) FILTER (WHERE status = 38) / 1e6)::numeric, 2) AS "GW decommissioned" FROM ( SELECT 'Solar' AS tech, "Bundesland"::bigint AS state, "Bruttoleistung" AS kw, "EinheitBetriebsstatus" AS status, "Inbetriebnahmedatum" AS ibn FROM mastr."EinheitenSolar" UNION ALL SELECT CASE "WindAnLandOderAufSee" WHEN 889 THEN 'Wind offshore' ELSE 'Wind onshore' END, "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWind" UNION ALL SELECT 'Battery storage', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenStromSpeicher" UNION ALL SELECT 'Biomass', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenBiomasse" UNION ALL SELECT 'Hydro', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenWasser" UNION ALL SELECT 'Combustion', "Bundesland"::bigint, "Bruttoleistung", "EinheitBetriebsstatus", "Inbetriebnahmedatum" FROM mastr."EinheitenVerbrennung" ) u GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Combustion units in operation by fuel

targets.rawSql: SELECT k."Wert" AS fuel, count(*) AS units, round((sum("Bruttoleistung") / 1e6)::numeric, 2) AS "GW" FROM mastr."EinheitenVerbrennung" e LEFT JOIN mastr."Katalogwerte" k ON k."Id" = e."Energietraeger" WHERE "EinheitBetriebsstatus" = 35 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST
